sourceDescription: Bharat B Bhatia presentation at the ITU Question 1/1 workshop, 28 September 2026; presenter claims are not treated as validated current ITU statistics

originalReview.method: Read the 12-page original with local PyMuPDF; rendered physical pages 2, 3, 5 and 11 at 2x and inspected the images. Page 5 values were cross-checked against PyMuPDF text and search rectangles.
originalReview.scopeGuard: The slide establishes an internal arithmetic discrepancy, not which FWA figure is correct or present-day India subscription totals.

draftQuestion.question: 在这份 2026 年演示的第 5 页，Total Subscribers 与 FWA Subscribers 两组汇总各自是否等于页上分项之和？如有不一致，差多少，并能否仅凭这一页断定哪个 FWA 数字正确？
draftQuestion.draftAnswer: Total Subscribers 一组相符：1,306 Mn wireless + 48 Mn wireline = 1,354 Mn。FWA 一组不符：13.2 Mn 5G FWA + 5.1 Mn UBR = 18.3 Mn，而页上汇总写 18.8 Mn，相差 0.5 Mn（50 万）。仅凭这一页无法判断汇总还是分项有误，不应猜测正确总数。
draftQuestion.sourceCoordinate: original PDF physical page 5, Total Subscribers and FWA Subscribers cards
draftQuestion.visualCheck: pass for all four values and units

rejectedUses: Do not turn the page 3 global meaningful-connectivity percentage into a current verified population fact.
Do not use page 11 WRC-27 proposed agenda/spectrum language as a current adopted decision.
Do not resolve the FWA contradiction from the slide by silently choosing one number.

localExposureScreen.distinctiveNumbersOrPhraseInOldText: No hits for 18.8 Mn, 13.2 Mn, 5.1 Mn UBR or FWA Subscribers in old holdout outputs; the product 300-case corpus has no FWA or UBR term. The local docs/src/scripts scan found the presenter name only in the new candidate registry.
localExposureScreen.limit: Term absence and old-blind-question topic separation do not establish complete semantic independence or provider-side non-exposure.

gates.remaining: The three occluded success blocks drove a product review repair and isolated clone regression on 2026-10-15, so this whole PDF and its conflict draft are development/regression only, not fresh independent Gold. Clone evidence confirms exclusion and original-page evidence; production registration and model-visible citation remain open.
